up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with associated pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1855 (Gonadotropin-releasing hormone receptor). Return the following columns: assay chembl_id (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), assay tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Filter activities to those with activity type IC50, and ensure the target has tax_id 9606 (human). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures appropriately. Do not impose any additional filters on assay type, document type, or data validity. Order the results by molecule chembl_id ascending, then assay chembl_id ascending.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1855' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, a.assay_id ASC;
